run_benchmarks: run ffcv micro benchmarks with a specified number of runs and warm-up iterations
run_benchmarks_with_pattern: run only benchmark tests matching a glob style pattern filter
run_benchmarks_to_csv: run ffcv micro benchmarks and export results to a CSV file
run_benchmarks_with_warmup: run ffcv micro benchmarks with configurable warm-up runs before measuring
run_benchmarks_default: run all ffcv micro benchmarks using default settings and print results to stdout
